fields.description:
## Context / Problem

Two epic siblings need live measurements this shared host cannot make: the sentinel story must
show before/after raw-output distributions (the directive itself changes what models emit —
measured E2: quote-in-prose 0% -> 100%), and the capability-rows story needs per-cell
PASS/FAIL facts for direct-Anthropic and OpenAI cells. The API keys live only in CI
(.github/workflows/external-integration.yml:118-119 scopes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY
per matrix provider arm), budget is limited, and keys must not be exposed to clients on shared
hosts — so measurement runs belong in a manual, capped CI job (operator decision recorded on
the epic).

## Approach

A harness under tests/external/ (the live-call convention, e.g. alongside
tests/external/_live_llm.py) parameterized from `.github/llm-providers/*.toml` (anthropic,
bedrock, openai): for each (provider, model) cell and each directive variant (current vs
sentinel), run a fixed n=10 of two production-shaped prompts (the df3a-shaped agentic
transcript with a quoted dep record, and a single-shot contract step), capture every raw reply
as an artifact file, and score deterministically: parse success under the current parser vs
the new selection+sentinel parser, and layout-class rates (prose, fenced, multi-object,
quoted-JSON). A new `workflow_dispatch`-only job (in external-integration.yml or a sibling
workflow reusing its per-provider secret scoping) uploads the artifact bundle; a
workflow-input call cap (default 300 calls/run) is enforced in the harness before any call.
Cells whose key is absent are recorded "unmeasured" and skipped without failing the job. The
committed E2 replies serve as the scorer's golden fixtures, so the scoring logic is fully
testable offline.

## Scope

- tests/external/ (new harness module) — cells, prompts, capture, scoring, cap
- .github/workflows/ (the dispatch job) — secret scoping copied from the existing per-provider
  matrix arms
- tests/unit/ (new scorer test file) — golden-count tests on committed fixtures
- tests/fixtures/ — E2 reply corpus committed as scorer goldens

## Testing

Unit tier for everything deterministic (the live boundary is the only mock-free external):

- Scorer reproduces the E2 golden counts on the committed fixture replies (exact numbers
  pinned).
- Credential-absent cell -> recorded "unmeasured", exit 0 (skip path is python logic, not
  YAML, so it is unit-testable).
- Call-budget cap: a matrix exceeding the cap refuses to start (asserted before any network
  object is constructed).
- The live run itself is operator-triggered and its evidence is the uploaded artifact — per
  the shared test-design standard §10, scored deterministically with predeclared n and
  thresholds; CI never gates on live-model nondeterminism.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Scorer golden tests pass on the committed E2 fixtures — checked by the new unit tests
      under `make test`.
- [x] Missing-credential cells record "unmeasured" without failing — checked by the skip-path
      unit test.
- [x] The per-run call budget is enforced and predeclared as a workflow input — checked by the
      cap unit test plus the input's presence in the workflow file.
- [x] [operator-attested] One workflow_dispatch run completes and its artifact (raw replies +
      before/after score table) is linked as a comment on this ticket.
